issuerName: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc.

segments.name: restaurant and retail
segments.description: Runs country stores with restaurants and gift shops selling home-style food and merchandise.
segments.evidence: Using these criteria, the Company manages its business on the basis of one operating and one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for meals in its restaurants and buy merchandise in the adjoining gift shops.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe that we achieve high retail sales per square foot of retail selling space (approximately $432 per square foot in 2026) as compared to traditional retail stores both by offering appealing merchandise and by having a significant source of customers who are typically our restaurant guests.
